scripts.fmt:frontend: oxfmt src scripts package.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json index.html README.md
scripts.fmt:frontend:check: oxfmt --check src scripts package.json vite.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json index.html README.md
scripts.fmt: bun run fmt:frontend && bun run fmt:rust
scripts.fmt:check: bun run fmt:frontend:check && bun run fmt:rust:check
